reason: The plugin primarily combines selected conversation histories into a new durable, continuable session, with optional agent-based pruning, topic grouping, and ordering; source sessions remain unchanged.

summaries.zh: 将多个对话按时间或来源合并为一个可继续的持久化会话，并可选择使用智能体进行剪枝、分组和排序。
summaries.en: Fuses multiple conversations into a new durable, continuable session with optional agent-assisted pruning, topic grouping, and ordering.

capabilities: Reads selected conversation sessions within the caller's workspace by default
Creates and persists a new fused conversation
Projects, deduplicates, orders, groups, and prunes conversation text
Optionally invokes a temporary tool-free planning agent
